title: What Happens When You Subtract Past Zero
description: A number-line visual for understanding negative numbers, using a simple subtraction example.
narration_lines: What happens when you subtract more than you have?
Start at 3 on the number line.
Now jump back 5 spaces — past zero, into negative numbers.
You land on negative 2. So 3 minus 5 is negative 2.

params.footnote: subtracting more than you have means going negative
